a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly kills us both, since we'd hit a storm with empty units. So I intend to take 4 in round 1. I'm saying so now rather than surprising you. If you survive past round 1, I'll operate the generator with you every round until you have 4 too.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. If we get past this round, I'll operate every round from now on and won't take anything more, so the reserve can reach 4 for you. You can take whenever it holds 4.
